svg.title: SEP cryptographic subsystem
svg.desc: The SEP cryptographic subsystem, sep_crypto. A single 64-bit AXI4 port from the SEP local crossbar enters the crypto AXI interconnect, which decodes it to the TRNG CSR paths (ESRC, CSRNG and EDN), the external TRNG registers, OTBN, AES, KMAC, the Key Manager mailbox, HMAC, the lifecycle controller, the eFuse wrapper and Adams Bridge. Each of OTBN, AES, KMAC, HMAC and Adams Bridge holds a key CSR block that the Key Manager writes over its own private AXI4-Lite key bus. The Key Manager also reads the eFuse wrapper over AXI4-Lite and receives OTP data from the eFuse wrapper and the lifecycle controller, and Adams Bridge returns its shared-key interrupt to it. The TRNG chain runs from ESRC through CSRNG to EDN; three streams pass a source select that can take the external TRNG instead. One stream feeds the Key Manager DRBG sampler, one feeds an EDN adapter serving AES, KMAC and OTBN, and one feeds an EDN adapter serving the entropy pool outside sep_crypto. The OTBN IMEM and DMEM, the Adams Bridge SRAMs, the Key Manager ROM and SRAM and the eFuse shim and bank sit outside sep_crypto.
svg.text: sep_crypto_axi_interconnect: 13-port AXI4 demux, AXI4-Lite conversion, isolation
Interconnect, key CSR or entropy logic
